dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (Most of the diary's pages have been torn out. It looks like the pirates didn't want them to fall into the hands of outsiders.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Uncle Onitaka set sail to send a woman away. According to her, the situation on the island is very bad indeed..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...A ship was stranded in the thunderstorm last night. It was a Sangonomiya ship, and it was badly damaged..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...It looks like the Shogunate won the naval battle last night. Well, when two fight each other, the third party wins..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...There was a samurai on the broken boat. Tough as nails, too. We've lost a few brothers, and even Kai was... We'll get him for sure..."
